ios.desc:
TCG Price Scanner for Lorcana is the fastest and easiest unofficial way to scan your Lorcana cards and track their market value. 

Simply scan a Lorcana card and get detailed information in seconds, including market prices, card name, set, edition, rarity, and more. 
Add cards to your collection, track total value, and sort cards by price, set, name, and more. 
Stay informed on the latest values and make smarter decisions when buying, selling, or trading cards.

With TCG Price Scanner for Lorcana, you can also browse all cards from the game and track your personal scan history. 
Build your collection, know the value of each card, and keep a precise history of what you’ve scanned and discovered.

=== Why Choose TCG Price Scanner for Lorcana? ===

• Instant card scanning: Quickly scan Lorcana cards and get all the details in one place.
• Accurate market prices: Stay up-to-date with current card prices and trends.
• Comprehensive card details: Access detailed information on each card, including set, edition, and rarity.
• History tracking: Keep a history of all your scanned cards and consult their value anytime.
• No sign-up or login required: Get started right away with no barriers to entry.
• Ad-free experience: Enjoy a seamless experience with no distractions.

=== Key Features ===

• Scan Lorcana cards: Get instant access to card details and current market prices.
• Collection management: Manage your card collection, track total value, and sort cards by price, set, name, and more.
• Track prices and value: Monitor the latest trends and make informed decisions.
• Card database: Browse all cards from Lorcana TCG and discover new sets and editions.
• History tracking: Easily keep track of your scanned cards and access their values anytime.
• No sign-up required: Just download and start scanning – no account needed.

=== How to Use TCG Price Scanner for Lorcana ===

1. Open the app and tap the scan button.
2. Align your camera to scan a Lorcana card.
3. Instantly get details such as current market price, name, edition, rarity.
4. Add the scanned card to your collection with one tap and view your total collection value.
5. Explore the card database to discover and track other cards from the Lorcana TCG.

With TCG Price Scanner for Lorcana, scanning and managing your trading card collection has never been easier. Whether you’re looking to check the value of a recent purchase or organizing your collection, this app gives you all the tools you need to stay on top

quotes.text:
Hey everyone,

I’m excited to share a new app I’ve been working on for the Lorcana TCG community! It is designed to help you get real-time market prices and detailed info about your Lorcana cards quickly and easily.

Here’s how it works:

• *Scan your card:* Just point your phone’s camera at the card and in 1-3 seconds, the app will pull up details like the card’s market prices, name, set, edition, and rarity.
• *Track prices:* Instantly see the card’s estimated value so you can make informed decisions about buying, selling, or trading.
• *Browse card sets:* The app lets you explore all the available cards.
• *Track scan history:* Keep a history of all the cards you’ve scanned.

The app is 100% free, with no paywalls or ads. It’s just a simple tool designed to help Lorcana players and collectors keep track of their cards and prices easily.

I’d love your feedback and suggestions!

Thanks.
